sources.title: Suolistosyövän seulontaohjelma: vuositilasto (seulontavuosi 2024)
sources.dataPeriod: 2024 screening round (findings reported by 15 May 2026; interval cancers for the 2022 round)
sources.reuseNotes: Full reference: Suomen Syöpärekisteri (Finnish Cancer Registry). Verbatim Finnish text from the official annual statistics page (English version: https://stats.cancerregistry.fi/joukkistilastot/colorectal.html). Table values are copied unchanged from the HTML tables, laid out as text lines. Full screening chain incl. colonoscopy attendance among test positives. Åland not included. Figures may be revised retrospectively in later releases. Not paginated.

sources.title: Suolistosyövän seulontaohjelman ennakkotilasto 2025
sources.dataPeriod: 2025 screening year, primary phase only (participation and test positivity; data submitted by 10 Oct 2026, events reported by 13 Oct 2026)
sources.reuseNotes: Full reference: Suomen Syöpärekisteri (Finnish Cancer Registry). PRELIMINARY statistics: primary phase only. No colonoscopy, findings or treatment data; the complete 2025 screening chain will be published in spring 2027, and the figures may still change. English version: https://stats.cancerregistry.fi/joukkistilastot/ennakkotilastot/colorectal_preliminary.html. First round with 72-year-olds included. Table values copied unchanged from the HTML tables. Not paginated.

sources.title: Colorectal cancer screening
sources.reuseNotes: Programme page (page metadata: last modified 2025-07-01). Verbatim English text. Note: it says screening 'currently applies to people aged 60–70', which predates the 2025 extension to 72-year-olds reported in the 2025 preliminary statistics. The Finnish page syoparekisteri.fi/seulonta/suolistosyovan-seulonta/ returned HTTP 403 and was not used.

sources.title: Yhdessä syöpää vastaan – Ihmislähtöistä syövän ehkäisyä ja hoitoa. Kansallinen syöpästrategia 2026–2035

sources.title: Together Against Cancer – Human-Centred Cancer Prevention and Care. National Cancer Strategy 2026–2035 (Finland)
sources.publisher: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health, Finland

sources.title: Kansallinen syöpästrategia 2026–2035: Toimeenpanon tiekartta vuosille 2026–2031
sources.reuseNotes: Full reference: Kansallisen syöpästrategian toimeenpanon käynnistämisen ohjausryhmä (FICAN-koordinoima). 111-page Finnish roadmap. Printed page numbers match PDF pages. page = page where the measure starts: 2.4.1 runs pp. 47–48, 2.4.5 pp. 50–51, 3.5.3 pp. 73–74. Amounts are estimated appropriations ('arvioitu tarvittava määräraha'), not decided budgets.

sources.title: Evaluation of Intervention Strategies to Improve Follow-Up Colonoscopy After Abnormal FIT/FOBT Result: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
sources.publisher: Chua et al., JAMA Internal Medicine
sources.reuseNotes: Full reference: JAMA Internal Medicine (Chua WY, Chew LX, Chan CKM, et al.; PMID 42832233; doi:10.1001/jamainternmed.2026.4827). PubMed abstract only, verbatim. 21 studies, 19,613 patients aged 50-75, both randomized and nonrandomized. The abstract does not name the study countries, and none are Finnish. Moderate to high heterogeneity. Pooled prevalence (47.8% vs 69.1%) compares control and intervention arms across different studies. These are not Finnish effect estimates.

sources.title: Evaluation of Interventions Intended to Increase Colorectal Cancer Screening Rates in the United States: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
sources.publisher: Dougherty et al., JAMA Internal Medicine
sources.reuseNotes: Full reference: JAMA Internal Medicine 2018;178(12):1645-1658 (Dougherty MK, Brenner AT, Crockett SD, et al.; PMID 30326005; doi:10.1001/jamainternmed.2018.4637). PubMed abstract only, verbatim. 73 US RCTs in clinical settings (average-risk adults), compared with usual care, mostly in opportunistic US settings, not in an organised mailed-FIT programme like Finland's. Patient navigation was NOT significantly associated with colonoscopy after an abnormal test (RR 1.21, 95% CI 0.92-1.60).

sources.title: Follow-up colonoscopy after abnormal stool-based colorectal cancer screening: a systematic review of completion, timeliness and implementation strategies
sources.reuseNotes: Full reference: BMJ Open 2026;16(10):e115052 (Naserrudin NA, Chong Woei Quan D, Adnan SB, et al.; PMID 42833723; doi:10.1136/bmjopen-2025-115052). PubMed abstract only, verbatim. 25 studies, mostly from high-income settings, synthesised narratively (no meta-analysis). Mostly observational, with low or very low certainty (GRADE). Describes the features of higher-performing pathways (tracking, ownership, navigation, scheduling) and gives no causal effect sizes.
